readout_other: sucrose preference test; tail suspension test; elevated plus-maze; LC-MS monoamines; BDNF western blot; c-Fos and H&E staining
direction_notes: DRN stimulation increased c-Fos-positive cells in DRN and improved CORT-induced depression-like behaviours and open-arm entry frequency; 5-HT rose non-significantly and NE fell.
safety_notes: H&E staining showed no damage or hemorrhage in the DRN; calculated temperature rise about 0.02 degC.

exposures.label: TUS of dorsal raphe nucleus, 30 min daily for 3 weeks

timing.protocol_description: 1 s stimulation duration with 1 s inter-stimulus interval, repeated for 30 min daily from week 4 to week 6 in freely behaving mice.

source_quotes.n_subjects: After that, depression mice models were established successfully and were divided into CORT (n = 8, figure 1) and CORT + TUS (n = 8) groups according to the sucrose preference index (SPI).
